text:
Maya Nguyen: Post-webinar follow-up plan: we need an employee-advocacy push, an official post for LinkedIn, and a concise X recap thread. Also routing rules for demo requests. Who can own each bit?
Evan Torres: I can run employee-advocacy comms + a short template for teammates to share. Want it lightweight.
Priya Singh: I'll own demo routing and qualification tags. Suggest tagging 'hot' for enterprise-size >200 or product-fit=yes.
Nina Rao: I'll write the LinkedIn longform recap and pull quotes from the Q&A. Need the recording and slide timestamps.
Maya Nguyen: Recording and timestamps will be uploaded to /marketing/webinars/2026_q2_recordings by EOD.
Abe Johnson: For X, I propose a 5-tweet thread: 1) hook + stat, 2) quick problem, 3) demo highlight, 4) sign-up CTA, 5) clip reply. I can draft.
SocialBot: Auto-schedule available: X thread + reply clip, LinkedIn article, and employee shareables. Do you want time offsets?
Maya Nguyen: Yes: X at Tue 10:00 PT, LinkedIn Tue 12:00 PT, employee share send Tues 13:00 PT. Employee shares should include suggested personal comment lines.
Priya Singh: For routing: route demo requests with company_size>200 or requested_meeting=true to AE queue. Others to nurture; tag source=webinar_q2. Will set Slack alerts to #inbound-leads with priority flag for 'hot'.
Sam Reed: I'll add form fields to the signup flow: company_size, role, interest_area. Also will ensure webhook includes utm and variant.
Nina Rao: Need legal check on the quote we want to use: "reduced inference latency by 2x" as an attendee quote. @LegalBot please advise.
LegalBot: Attendee quotes must be anonymized or have explicit permission. The phrase "reduced inference latency by 2x" is okay if it's attributed to "attendee feedback" or a named customer with consent.
Abe Johnson: For the clip reply, can we make a 20s highlight focusing on the demo? I'll coordinate with @Sam for the file.
Sam Reed: Will export a 20s MP4 and upload to the creative folder. Include .vtt captions.
Evan Torres: Employee template will be two short options: 1) straightforward share with CTA, 2) personal take + CTA. I'll post templates in #marketing-docs.
Maya Nguyen: Metrics to monitor first 72 hours: signups, demo requests, clicks, and employee shares. Evan, set up a quick dashboard or report.
Evan Torres: Will build a GA dashboard + slack daily summary for 3 days.
Priya Singh: Also recommend a 1-hour rolling alert when a hot lead converts so an SDR can reach out quickly.
Maya Nguyen: Good. Recap owners: employee comms (Evan), LinkedIn longform (Nina), X thread (Abe), routing (Priya), exports (Sam), legal (LegalBot). Drop final copy for review by tomorrow 5pm.
SocialBot: Reminder set for 2026-04-28 09:00 PT for final check-in.
Maya Nguyen: Thanks team!
